brief: Identify which payment date, amount or condition is still unknown in a work offer.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Clarify the offer"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Aclara la oferta"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Esclareça a oferta"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify which payment date, amount or condition is still unknown in a work offer.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Know what must happen before a promised payment arrives.
instruction.misconception: Treat an incomplete work offer as a confirmed amount available on a known date.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: An offer promises 90 dollars after approval, without a date. Clarify approval and payment timing before planning bills.
An amount alone does not show when money becomes available.
An undefined condition leaves the payment trigger unclear.
A date cannot supply the missing amount.
The agreed terms support later payment checks.
A possible offer is not a confirmed payment commitment.
An open-ended trigger leaves payment timing uncertain.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
